## Pre-Merge Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off with `git commit -s` (required for DCO)
- [ ] CI passes (build, test, lint, format)
- [ ] If behavior changed: spec section (§N from [docs/spec.md](../../docs/spec.md)) is referenced in code or PR
- [ ] No new hardcoded numeric thresholds — all constants belong in `Config` struct
- [ ] Accessibility considered: VoiceOver navigation tested if UI changed
